description:
Extend the S2D pipeline to carry `release_id` and `channel` end-to-end from DM orchestrator through to LPBS upload.

1. Add `ReleaseID` and `Channel` fields to S2D's `Config`/`DeployConfig` and `UploadRequest` structs.
2. Pass `release_id` in the LPBS commit step request body.
3. Use `channelToVariantKey(channel)` to set the correct variant_key on upload instead of hardcoding.

The existing 4-step upload flow (presign → S3 → commit → apply) doesn't need structural changes — just additional fields passed through.
name: s2d-pipeline-release-id-and-channel
title: Add Release ID And Channel To S2D Pipeline Data Flow
